title: Microsoft Outage: Why Services Are Down and When They Will Be Fixed
description:
Microsoft 365 outage affects Outlook, Teams and Copilot globally. Learn why services are down and when they will be fixed.

In this video, we break down the Microsoft 365 outage that disrupted Outlook, Teams, and Copilot worldwide. You will learn what caused the network upgrade issue, why it affected so many services, and Microsoft's latest updates on recovery progress.

- What caused the Microsoft outage and the network upgrade issue
- Which services like Outlook and Teams are affected
- Microsoft's progress toward full recovery
- Why this matters for your daily work and school life
